sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pos(frame,color):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def items(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='c' and 8<=n['pixels']<=12:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    return sorted(out)
def bframe(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='B' and n['pixels']>=12:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
for i in range(6):
    action(['LEFT'], intent='explore')
    if last_action_result.get('no_impact') or last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        break
    print(f"step{i}: P={pos(current_frame,'N')} O={pos(current_frame,'O')} B={bframe(current_frame)} items={items(current_frame)}")
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def pos(frame,color):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def items(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='c' and 8<=n['pixels']<=12:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    return sorted(out)
def bframe(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='B' and n['pixels']>=12:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
